description: This file defines the ProjectsPage React component, which manages the display, creation, editing, and deletion of project entries in a project management frontend. It handles fetching project data from an API, user interactions for CRUD operations via modals and buttons, and displays the list of projects in a table format.

methods.name: ProjectsPage()
methods.description: Main React functional component for the Projects page, managing state, API interactions, and rendering the user interface.

methods.name: resetForm
methods.description: Resets the project form fields to their default empty values.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the list of projects from the API and updates the component state.

methods.name: onEdit
methods.description: Prepares the form for editing an existing project and opens the modal.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Prepares the form for creating a new project and opens the modal.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Saves the project data, either creating a new project or updating an existing one, then reloads the project list.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a project after user confirmation and reloads the project list.
